articles.title: 伤害感受器生物钟基因以性别和时间依赖性方式控制小鼠的兴奋性与疼痛感知
articles.originalTitle: Nociceptor circadian clock genes control excitability and pain perception in mice in a sex- and time-dependent manner.
articles.abstract: Nociception is critical for pain perception and survival and begins with the activation of nociceptors, specialized sensory neurons located in the dorsal root ganglia (DRGs). Both sex and circadian rhythms, governed by clock genes, seem to play a significant role in modulating pain perception. However, the potential interaction between circadian rhythms and sex differences in nociception at the peripheral level has been largely overlooked. Here, we first report that DRGs from mice express core clock genes in a time- and sex-dependent manner. Using whole-cell recordings in intact DRGs and optogenetic stimulation of Nav1.8-expressing neurons, we demonstrate that male nociceptors exhibit reduced excitability during the night, while female nociceptor excitability remains stable across time points. Disruption of the core clock gene Bmal1 in Nav1.8-expressing neurons not only diminished nociceptor activity but also abolished the nighttime reduction in heat sensitivity observed in males, highlighting a pivotal role for the molecular clock in regulating nociception. Transcriptomic and immunohistochemistry analyses, voltage-clamp recordings, and pharmacological experiments identified the voltage-gated chloride channel ClC-2 as a key mediator for the observed fluctuations in male nociceptor excitability and heat sensitivity. This work opens promising avenues for chronobiology-inspired strategies in pain management tailored to sex-specific mechanisms.

sections.text: 伤害感受对于疼痛感知和生存至关重要，始于伤害感受器的激活，这些特化的感觉神经元位于背根神经节（DRGs）中。性别和由时钟基因控制的昼夜节律似乎都在调节疼痛感知中发挥重要作用。然而，昼夜节律与性别差异在外周水平伤害感受中的潜在相互作用在很大程度上被忽视了。在此，我们首先报道小鼠DRGs以时间和性别依赖的方式表达核心时钟基因。通过在完整DRG中进行全细胞记录和对表达Nav1.8的神经元进行光遗传学刺激，我们证明雄性伤害感受器在夜间表现出降低的兴奋性，而雌性伤害感受器的兴奋性在不同时间点保持稳定。在表达Nav1.8的神经元中破坏核心时钟基因Bmal1不仅减弱了伤害感受器活动，还消除了在雄性中观察到的夜间热敏感性降低，突显了分子时钟在调节伤害感受中的关键作用。转录组学和免疫组织化学分析、电压钳记录和药理学实验确定了电压门控氯通道ClC-2是观察到的雄性伤害感受器兴奋性和热敏感性波动的关键介质。这项工作为基于时间生物学的疼痛管理策略开辟了有前景的途径，这些策略针对性别特异性机制。

articles.originalTitle: NH600001, an etomidate analogue, provides gastrointestinal endoscopy sedation/anesthesia and reduces adrenocortical depression: two randomized controlled trials.
articles.abstract: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of NH600001, a novel etomidate derivative, in gastrointestinal endoscopy, as well as its impact on adrenocortical function, two multicenter, double-blind, randomized, controlled clinical trials(NH600001-21 [Phase II trial] and NH600001-31 [Phase III trial]) were conducted in China. In NH600001-21, 160 gastroscopy subjects were randomized 1:1:1:1 to receive NH600001 (0.20, 0.25, or 0.30 mg/kg) and etomidate (0.30 mg/kg). In NH600001-31, 344 gastroscopy or colonoscopy subjects were randomized in a 1:1 ratio to receive NH600001 (0.25 mg/kg) and etomidate (0.30 mg/kg). The primary efficacy outcome was the rate of endoscopic success. Additionally, Safety and effects on adrenocortical function were also assessed. In NH600001-21, the 0.25 mg/kg NH600001 showed non-inferiority to etomidate based on the prespecified non-inferiority margin of -8% (Rate Difference [95% confidence interval], 5.0[-4.49 to 14.49]), whereas the 0.20 mg/kg and 0.30 mg/kg NH600001 did not meet statistical non-inferiority criteria (0[-11.54 to 11.54]; 0[-11.54 to 11.54]). The area under curve (AUC) of plasma cortisol change values within 0-4 h (∆Cortisol AUC(0-4h)) were significantly higher in the NH600001 treatment groups than in the etomidate group (P < 0.01). In NH600001-31, NH600001 (0.25 mg/kg) showed non-inferiority to etomidate (1.16[-0.44 to 2.76]). ∆Cortisol AUC(0-4h) in the NH600001 group, versus the etomidate group, were significantly higher (P < 0.001). Furthermore, NH600001 had a safety profile comparable to etomidate and elicited fewer myoclonus adverse events. In Conclusions, NH600001 has a sedative/anesthetic effect comparable to etomidate while reducing the risk of adrenocortical depression with a favorable safety profile. sections.text: 为了评估新型依托咪酯衍生物NH600001在胃肠内镜检查中的疗效和安全性及其对肾上腺皮质功能的影响，在中国进行了两项多中心、双盲、随机、对照临床试验（NH600001-21 [II期试验] 和 NH600001-31 [III期试验]）。在NH600001-21中，160名胃镜检查受试者按1:1:1:1随机分配接受NH600001（0.20、0.25或0.30 mg/kg）和依托咪酯（0.30 mg/kg）。在NH600001-31中，344名胃镜或结肠镜检查受试者按1:1比例随机分配接受NH600001（0.25 mg/kg）和依托咪酯（0.30 mg/kg）。主要疗效结局是内镜检查成功率。此外，还评估了安全性和对肾上腺皮质功能的影响。在NH600001-21中，基于预设的非劣效性界值-8%（率差[95%置信区间]，5.0[-4.49至14.49]），0.25 mg/kg NH600001显示出与依托咪酯相比的非劣效性，而0.20 mg/kg和0.30 mg/kg NH600001未达到统计学非劣效性标准（0[-11.54至11.54]；0[-11.54至11.54]）。NH600001治疗组0-4小时内血浆皮质醇变化值的曲线下面积（∆Cortisol AUC(0-4h)）显著高于依托咪酯组（P < 0.01）。在NH600001-31中，NH600001（0.25 mg/kg）显示出与依托咪酯相比的非劣效性（1.16[-0.44至2.76]）。与依托咪酯组相比，NH600001组的∆Cortisol AUC(0-4h)显著更高（P < 0.001）。此外，NH600001的安全性与依托咪酯相当，且引起的肌阵挛不良事件更少。总之，NH600001具有与依托咪酯相当的镇静/麻醉效果，同时降低了肾上腺皮质抑制的风险，且安全性良好。Chictr.org.cn标识符：ChiCTR2300069841，ChiCTR2400084095。临床试验编号和注册网址：NH60001-21，标识符，ChiCTR2300069841（中国长沙；主要研究者：欧阳文；首次注册日期：2023年3月28日），https://www.chictr.org.cn；NH60001-31，标识符，ChiCTR2400084095（中国长沙；主要研究者：欧阳文；首次注册日期：2024年5月10日），https://www.chictr.org.cn。

articles.title: 老年患者麻醉后监护病房脑电α功率与谵妄：AlphaMax试验第一部分——维持期地氟醚和芬太尼滴定效应
articles.originalTitle: EEG alpha power and delirium in the postanaesthesia care unit in older adults: the AlphaMax trial part 1 - effect of desflurane and fentanyl titration during maintenance.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: Frontal EEG alpha oscillations might reflect an ideal state of general anaesthesia with adequate antinociception. Low alpha power has been associated with a vulnerable brain phenotype at greater risk of postoperative delirium. This arm of the AlphaMax randomised trial aimed to determine if alpha oscillations could be maximised by EEG-guided titration of anaesthesia, and if this might reduce delirium in the postanaesthesia care unit (PACU). METHODS: Male and female patients, aged >/=60 yr, were randomised to EEG-guided dose titration (targeting oscillatory alpha power) or routine care. Both groups received a standardised desflurane-fentanyl-based anaesthetic technique avoiding burst suppression. PACU delirium was assessed by blinded observers. RESULTS: For feasibility reasons, we reduced the sample size and were underpowered for PACU delirium. A total of 200 patients aged 73 (SD 7) yr were included. The titration group received more fentanyl (median [interquartile range] 650 [500-850] mug vs 500 [350-600] mug, P<0.0001) and less desflurane (maintenance end-tidal concentration mean [SD] 3.9 [0.7] vol% vs 4.4 [0.8%], vol% P<0.0001) than the control group. Oscillatory alpha power was greater in the titration group early after surgical incision (+0.8 dB, P=0.008), but this effect was not sustained as surgery progressed. Titration resulted in absent desflurane-alpha correlation in the intervention group (r=-0.020, 95% confidence interval -0.155 to 0.115) and a negative association in the control group (r=-0.228, 95% confidence interval -0.396 to -0.059). The incidence of PACU delirium was similar between groups (37% vs 33%, P=0.553). CONCLUSIONS: EEG-guided titration of fentanyl and desflurane anaesthesia had a limited enhancing effect on oscillatory alpha power with no appreciable difference in clinical outcomes. sections.heading: BACKGROUND
sections.text: 额叶脑电图α振荡可能反映了具有充分抗伤害感受的全身麻醉的理想状态。低α功率与术后谵妄风险增加的脆弱大脑表型相关。AlphaMax随机试验的这一分支旨在确定是否可以通过脑电图引导的麻醉滴定来最大化α振荡，以及这是否可以减少麻醉后监护病房（PACU）中的谵妄。

sections.heading: METHODS
sections.text: 年龄≥60岁的男性和女性患者被随机分配至脑电图引导的剂量滴定（以振荡α功率为目标）或常规护理。两组均接受标准化的地氟烷-芬太尼为基础的麻醉技术，避免爆发性抑制。PACU谵妄由盲法观察者评估。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 由于可行性原因，我们减少了样本量，并且对于PACU谵妄的检验效能不足。共纳入200例患者，年龄73（SD 7）岁。滴定组比对照组接受了更多的芬太尼（中位数[四分位距] 650 [500-850] μg vs 500 [350-600] μg，P<0.0001）和更少的地氟烷（维持呼气末浓度平均值[SD] 3.9 [0.7] vol% vs 4.4 [0.8] vol%，P<0.0001）。手术切口后早期，滴定组的振荡α功率更大（+0.8 dB，P=0.008），但随着手术进展，这种效应未能持续。滴定导致干预组地氟烷-α相关性消失（r=-0.020，95%置信区间 -0.155至0.115），而对照组呈负相关（r=-0.228，95%置信区间 -0.396至-0.059）。两组PACU谵妄的发生率相似（37% vs 33%，P=0.553）。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS
sections.text: 脑电图引导的芬太尼和地氟烷麻醉滴定对振荡α功率的增强作用有限，临床结果无明显差异。

articles.title: 预防性去甲肾上腺素输注减少心脏手术患者麻醉诱导期间严重低血压：一项随机对照单中心临床试验
articles.originalTitle: Prophylactic norepinephrine infusion to reduce severe hypotension during induction of anaesthesia in patients undergoing cardiac surgery: a randomised controlled single-centre clinical trial.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: The EPITUBE trial aimed to determine whether a prophylactic infusion of norepinephrine reduced severe hypotension after induction of general anaesthesia and tracheal intubation in patients undergoing cardiac surgery. METHODS: We performed a randomised controlled single-centre clinical trial including patients undergoing cardiac surgery. In the experimental group, infusion of norepinephrine started from the start of preoxygenation at an infusion rate of 0.06 mug kg(-1) min(-1), secondarily titrated to maintain mean arterial pressure (MAP) between 65 and 80 mm Hg. In the control group, ephedrine was administered if MAP decreased <65 mm Hg. Primary outcome was the occurrence of MAP <55 mm Hg. Secondary measures included tracheal intubation-related complications, postoperative complications, duration of ICU stay, and mortality. RESULTS: Of 210 patients randomised and analysed in the intention-to-treat analysis, the incidence of severe hypotension was not different between the groups: 43.8% in the norepinephrine group vs 44.8% in the control group (odds ratio 0.96, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.56-1.66, P=0.99). The incidence of MAP <65 mm Hg was lower in the norepinephrine group than in the control group: 63.8% vs 78.1% (odds ratio 0.49, 95% CI 0.26-0.90, P=0.02). The rate of intubation-related complications was not different between the norepinephrine and control groups, 22.9% vs 32.4%, respectively (odds ratio 0.62, 95% CI 0.33-1.14, P=0.13). There was no difference in postoperative outcomes including acute kidney injury, time on ventilator, or length of stay in the ICU. CONCLUSIONS: In patients undergoing cardiac surgery, infusion of norepinephrine before general anaesthesia at a starting dose of 0.06 mug kg(-1) min(-1) did not reduce severe hypotension compared with on-demand ephedrine. CLINICAL TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT05335954.

sections.heading: BACKGROUND
sections.text: EPITUBE试验旨在确定预防性输注去甲肾上腺素是否能减少接受心脏手术患者在全麻诱导和气管插管后的严重低血压。

sections.heading: METHODS
sections.text: 我们进行了一项随机对照单中心临床试验，纳入接受心脏手术的患者。在实验组中，从预充氧开始即以0.06 μg kg(-1) min(-1)的速率输注去甲肾上腺素，随后根据平均动脉压（MAP）维持在65至80 mm Hg之间进行滴定。在对照组中，如果MAP降至65 mm Hg以下，则给予麻黄碱。主要结局是MAP低于55 mm Hg的发生率。次要指标包括气管插管相关并发症、术后并发症、ICU住院时间和死亡率。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 在随机分组并纳入意向性治疗分析的210名患者中，严重低血压的发生率在两组之间没有差异：去甲肾上腺素组为43.8%，对照组为44.8%（比值比0.96，95%置信区间[CI] 0.56-1.66，P=0.99）。MAP低于65 mm Hg的发生率在去甲肾上腺素组低于对照组：63.8%对78.1%（比值比0.49，95% CI 0.26-0.90，P=0.02）。插管相关并发症的发生率在去甲肾上腺素组和对照组之间没有差异，分别为22.9%和32.4%（比值比0.62，95% CI 0.33-1.14，P=0.13）。术后结局包括急性肾损伤、呼吸机使用时间或ICU住院时间均无差异。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS
sections.text: 在接受心脏手术的患者中，在全麻前以0.06 μg kg(-1) min(-1)的起始剂量输注去甲肾上腺素，与按需使用麻黄碱相比，并未减少严重低血压。

abstractTranslation.fullText: BACKGROUND: EPITUBE试验旨在确定预防性输注去甲肾上腺素是否能减少接受心脏手术患者在全麻诱导和气管插管后的严重低血压。METHODS: 我们进行了一项随机对照单中心临床试验，纳入接受心脏手术的患者。在实验组中，从预充氧开始即以0.06 μg kg(-1) min(-1)的速率输注去甲肾上腺素，随后根据平均动脉压（MAP）维持在65至80 mm Hg之间进行滴定。在对照组中，如果MAP降至65 mm Hg以下，则给予麻黄碱。主要结局是MAP低于55 mm Hg的发生率。次要指标包括气管插管相关并发症、术后并发症、ICU住院时间和死亡率。RESULTS: 在随机分组并纳入意向性治疗分析的210名患者中，严重低血压的发生率在两组之间没有差异：去甲肾上腺素组为43.8%，对照组为44.8%（比值比0.96，95%置信区间[CI] 0.56-1.66，P=0.99）。MAP低于65 mm Hg的发生率在去甲肾上腺素组低于对照组：63.8%对78.1%（比值比0.49，95% CI 0.26-0.90，P=0.02）。插管相关并发症的发生率在去甲肾上腺素组和对照组之间没有差异，分别为22.9%和32.4%（比值比0.62，95% CI 0.33-1.14，P=0.13）。术后结局包括急性肾损伤、呼吸机使用时间或ICU住院时间均无差异。CONCLUSIONS: 在接受心脏手术的患者中，在全麻前以0.06 μg kg(-1) min(-1)的起始剂量输注去甲肾上腺素，与按需使用麻黄碱相比，并未减少严重低血压。CLINICAL TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov标识符：NCT05335954。

articles.title: 中国全凭静脉麻醉临床实践指南：系统评价与专家共识建议
articles.originalTitle: Chinese clinical practice guidelines for total intravenous anaesthesia: a systematic review and expert consensus-based recommendations(☆).
articles.abstract: Total intravenous anaesthesia (TIVA) has been widely used for general anaesthesia in clinical practice. In order to further promote the standardised application of TIVA in China, the Chinese Society of Anesthesiology of the Chinese Medical Association organised experts to formulate these clinical practice guidelines for TIVA. After collection and selection of clinical questions, the working group conducted rigorous searches of the literature, formulated recommendations, and reached a consensus. A total of 22 recommendations were made on 12 clinical issues, including the indications, contraindications, and advantages of TIVA, use of depth of anaesthesia monitoring during implementation, pharmacological characteristics of available i.v. anaesthetic drugs, selection and use of drugs in target- and nontarget-controlled infusion modes, and precautions for application of TIVA in special populations, thus providing guidance for anaesthetists to standardise implementation of TIVA.

sections.text: 全静脉麻醉（TIVA）已在临床实践中广泛用于全身麻醉。为进一步促进TIVA在中国的规范化应用，中华医学会麻醉学分会组织专家制定了这些TIVA临床实践指南。在收集和筛选临床问题后，工作组进行了严格的文献检索，制定了推荐意见，并达成了共识。针对12个临床问题共提出了22条推荐意见，包括TIVA的适应证、禁忌证和优势，实施过程中麻醉深度监测的使用，现有静脉麻醉药物的药理学特性，靶控和非靶控输注模式下药物的选择和使用，以及TIVA在特殊人群中应用的注意事项，从而为麻醉医师规范化实施TIVA提供指导。
